# Manor Laundromat

Manor Laundromat is a self-service laundromat located at 876 Manor Street, Lancaster, PA 17603.
Phone: (717) 925-7480
Hours: Open daily, 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM, including holidays. Last wash recommended by 9:00 PM.
Website: https://www.manor-laundromat.com
Google rating: 4.9 stars (17 reviews, November 2026)
Languages: The website and in-store instructions are available in English and Spanish (Español).

## Services

Self-service washing and drying. No attendant on-site; call (717) 925-7480 during open hours for help.

## Payment

- Laundry cards cost $1 at the kiosk inside the laundromat and can be reloaded with cash, credit, or debit.
- Smartphone payment via the LaundryCat app.
- Reload bonus: load $20 onto a laundry card or the LaundryCat app and get a $4 bonus ($24 of value).

## Washers

- 30 lb washer: $4.75 per cycle (5 machines) — ideal for everyday laundry and towels
- 40 lb washer: $6.25 per cycle (10 machines) — ideal for large family loads
- 60 lb washer: $8.00 per cycle (3 machines) — ideal for comforters and blankets
- 80 lb washer: $11.00 per cycle (2 machines) — ideal for bulky and oversized items

## Dryers

All dryers hold up to 50 lbs.
- $1.75 for the first 30 minutes
- $0.25 per additional 6 minutes

## Amenities

- Free Wi-Fi
- Comfortable seating
- Ample on-site parking
- Climate-controlled space
- Fully renovated interior
- Dexter X-Series commercial machines
- On-site vending for detergent, fabric softener, and dryer sheets (Tide, Gain, Downy, and more)
- Security cameras; well-lit interior and parking lot
